questions: Are you still at the site, or have you left?

steps.summary: Simulated call Yara Sivellin. I'm still at Velantora Helsinki, waiting as I said in my last message. No, reception hasn't found or released the BMW M4 since I last wrote. I don't have a time for a second attempt yet, so please let me know when the car is actually ready.

input.text: Driver Yara Sivellin is still at Velantora Helsinki at 12:00. Reception has not found or released the BMW M4. The driver has no time for a second attempt and wants Bahn to arrange travel back today if the car is not released soon.

The site says the car is not in its release queue. Staff see a similar stock reference but will not hand it over without confirmation. The customer says their system still lists this branch and asks Bahn not to take a different car. The customer has not written again since 10:39.
The pickup slot was 21 Oct 09:00–11:00 and is now over. At 10:57 the driver said they could wait another 30 minutes, so that wait ran out around 11:27. No travel home is booked or quoted.
The delivery promise is 26 Oct 11:00–16:00 in Turku, so a later pickup this week can probably still meet it.

draft_message.body: Calling about the BMW M4, plate DEMO-FI-MRF24B, order CD-420593. Our driver has been at Velantora Helsinki since about 10:00 your time. Reception cannot find the car in its release list. They can see a similar stock reference but will not hand it over without confirmation. Ask: 1) Which site has this exact car (VIN and plate) right now? 2) Who at that site can release it to our driver, and can they tell reception today? 3) If not today, what day and time can the car be released? Say clearly that we will not take the similar stock car unless the VIN and plate match. Mention that delivery is still promised for 26 Oct 11:00–16:00 your time in Turku.

input.what_happens_next: You call the customer's stock team with this brief, then log their answer. If the car is confirmed at this branch and release is authorised, I tell the driver to check the VIN and plate before collecting. If not, I tell the driver to leave, propose travel back for them, and propose a new pickup date.
